kind: routine typed-result clarification; preserves accepted subjects and all ceilings
rule: One carrier unwrap produces one typed decoded representation. Parsing object/array JSON bytes as part of Buffer/base64/base64url/URL unwrap is within that same depth step. If that result is itself a JSON string requiring another JSON unwrap, the next representation increments depth again.
nodes_rule: Count each dict/list/scalar in the original parsed input and each additional typed decoded representation. Keys are scanned but are not nodes. Intermediate parser byte/string temporaries are not separate decoded representations and are not double counted.

examples.input: explicit base64 envelope encoding object JSON
explicit base64 envelope encoding a JSON string containing object JSON

null_empty_policy: This holder corpus uses only null and empty string as absence-of-secret lawful values. No exemption for arbitrary redaction markers or unresolved placeholder strings is added.
